pages.text: As your shipping empire grows, linking haulers to individual docks becomes tedious. Welcome to centralized logistics: The $(2)Zephyr Hub$() acts as a master router, managing entire airports dynamically.
Crafting the Zephyr Hub. Right-click it with an empty hand to assign a custom network name.

pages.title: Zephyr Cables
pages.text: A Hub on its own does nothing. You must connect it to your Docks using $(2)Zephyr Cables$(). The Hub will scan up to 256 connected blocks, forming a unified network. Place your Docks around the cables, and the Hub will detect them automatically.
Zephyr Cables are cheap to produce and essential for expanding your airport's capacity.

pages.title: Smart Routing
pages.text: Instead of linking your Hauler to a Dock, link it to the $(2)Hub$(). When the Hauler launches, the Hub will rapidly scan its network and assign it the first $(a)Free$() dock available. The dock will instantly be $(e)Reserved$() to prevent mid-air collisions.

pages.title: Hub Monitor
pages.text: Need to oversee your airport? Perform a $(2)Shift + Right-Click$() with an empty hand on the Hub to open the $(2)Hub Monitor$(). This interface lets you page through every connected dock, showing real-time coordinates and precise traffic statuses.

pages.title: Memory Link
pages.text: Haulers are smart. Even though the Hub diverts them to a specific dock, the Hauler retains its $(2)Original Hub Memory$(). When you pick up the landed balloon, it will remember its master Hub, ready to be dispatched again without needing a re-link!
